beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their value depends on making a specific barrier easier to inspect and redesign.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the introduction’s method and the example of the anti-consumption assistant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the chapter matching the obstacle your own project actually encounters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The funding chapters expose the difference between missing evidence and a missing sponsor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later chapters test how proposed solutions can preserve legitimate refusal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits builders, policy readers, and writers imagining plausible institutional futures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its full cases teach you to distinguish a weak idea from an incompatible selection environment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is a concrete gain: a better diagnosis before another proposal repeats the same failure.
